trace.question: How long do we have to dispute a missing-item chargeback on a DoorDash order?
trace.answer:
I couldn't find a DoorDash dispute deadline in your written policies. A search on "DoorDash" returned nothing, and a search on marketplace disputes and chargebacks returned only the refund and online-order rules. Those rules cover refunds and Square Online pickup orders, not DoorDash chargebacks. [House Policy §3, Refunds] [House Policy §5, Online Orders]

Without a rule in your policies, I won't guess at a number of days. Check DoorDash's merchant terms or your DoorDash portal for the exact window. It's safest to file as soon as you see the chargeback. If you give me the order, I can pull it up and propose a dispute for you to approve.

trace.answer:
I couldn't find an answer in your written policies. They have no section on DoorDash, and none on marketplace disputes, chargebacks, or missing items. The only nearby result was [House Policy §5, Online Orders], which covers uncollected Square Online pickup orders and doesn't apply here.

I won't guess at a deadline. You can find the dispute window in your DoorDash merchant agreement or in the DoorDash merchant portal. If you add the marketplace terms to your policy documents, I can look the deadline up and cite it. If you have a specific order in mind, tell me and I can pull its details. Disputing it would still need your approval.
